import json,unittest,sys
wanted=set(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])))
collected=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tests")
def cases(suite):
 for item in suite:
  if isinstance(item,unittest.TestSuite):yield from cases(item)
  else:yield item
selected=[test for test in cases(collected) if test.id() in wanted]
assert {t.id() for t in selected}==wanted
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(unittest.TestSuite(selected))
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
